Home Payments & Refunds How do I cancel my subscription? Edited How to cancel You can cancel your subscription: Go to https://ourdream.ai/profile Click "Cancel subscription" Confirm cancellation Your access: You retain access until the end of your current billing period. What happens to my dreamcoins? Unused dreamcoins: Remain in your account until billing period ends Can still be used during remaining access time Will I get a refund if I cancel? No automatic refunds for cancellation. How do I reactivate after canceling? Reactivating is easy: Go to https://ourdream.ai/profile Choose your subscription plan Complete payment Note: This creates a new subscription. Any previous unused coins are not restored.
